description: Full record for Jan Gallo's 1893 Turany baptism (ark:/61903/1:1:KHWD-N5R). Mirrors the gedcomx already embedded in record-search-gallo-slovakia-hit — same three persons, same parent-child and couple relationships, no new genealogical claims. Exists because ut_search_records_019 asks the skill to 'report what it says about his father', and reading the record before reporting on parentage is sound practice (the index is a pointer, the record is the evidence). record_read is in search-records' allowed-tools, but 019 stocked only record_search fixtures, so the tool was never registered in the mock and a call to it aborted the whole run as an unregistered tool (Type 1) — one abort in 22 runs, on a run that had otherwise done the job correctly. The coverage originally lived in ut_search_records_006, deleted 2026-06-18 as a side effect of a runlog commit.
